cases.scenario: Record source revision, versions, original archive hashes and baseline test outcomes; repeated preservation check keeps E02/E03 identical.
Install actual beta.3 and seed through its supported APIs; prove old app login, encrypted data and expected workflow outcomes before any upgrade.
Install original beta.4 and seed recovery/password state; prove established account credentials before maintenance upgrade.
Fresh non-admin installation on Windows 10 Home and Windows 11 Home, no developer dependencies; only current-user paths/shortcuts appear.
Offline install, launch and removal; no attempted Git/npm/pip/vendor connection.

Package path with spaces, apostrophe, ampersand, parentheses, Unicode, percent and exclamation variants; no argument corruption or command injection. Unsupported lengths fail before mutation with clear guidance.
Missing EXE/assets/config rules, digest mismatch, truncated ZIP and artifact collision; installation aborts without touching an existing app/data.

Wrong architecture, unsupported PowerShell, enforced organizational script restriction, read-only install destination and insufficient space; no elevation/persistent policy change or partial installation.
Start Menu/Desktop launch, repeat launch, second simultaneous launch; correct single runtime reused and browser opens correct configured URL.
Unrelated process owns configured port; it survives and app reports conflict. Existing correct owned instance is reused.
Slow startup succeeds within configured deadline; timeout reports failure, retains logs safely and does not leave an ungated orphan.
First-use password change and recovery screen; existing workflow defaults, LLM off, live gates off, LOC warning visible.
Missing .env with data, missing selected DB, conflicting aliases, outside-root DB, reparse/UNC roots and unknown install owner; recovery-needed result, no new key/profile.
beta.3 stopped -> enhanced beta.4; expected build, same data identity, accounts, settings, encrypted uploads and clinical evidence preserved.

beta.3 running with browser tab open -> upgrade; only owned processes stop; in-flight write either completes before snapshot or fails without a partial record; existing browser cannot write during validation.
Original beta.4 -> enhanced beta.4 build; recovery/password state survives; package/build identity changes and old ZIP is unchanged.
Existing custom local DB filename/port and both generated/canonical config aliases; correct DB reused, no empty default DB created.
Re-run exact candidate: default Open/no-op, explicitly selected Repair restores damaged program assets and preserves data.
Newer app/build/schema, beta.10 ordering, unknown receipt version, equal-build different payload; downgrade/collision rejected before mutation.
Stop failure, ambiguous PID ownership, PID reuse and surviving PyInstaller child; abort before snapshot/swap and preserve unrelated processes.

Backup path unwritable/full, tampered backup/protected-key material, incomplete manifest and failed SQLite integrity; no payload activation and old profile retained. Genuine cross-user rejection is tested separately in Home R07.
Locked EXE/asset/shortcut, copy error and each program rename failure; verified rollback returns old program plus matching data and nonzero operation code.
Candidate import/migration/startup/health/version/asset failure; maintenance routes stay gated and paired rollback restores beta.3 usability.
UI/static load succeeds but returned build/instance/data identity wrong; do not commit based on a random service's HTTP 200.
Two concurrent installers, upgrade vs restore/uninstall, and launch during pending journal; only one owner mutates state, other receives busy/recovery result.
Repeated upgrade/repair/recovery cycles; no duplicated users, source records, clinical versions, shortcuts or reset credentials.
Kill controller before/after every durable journal transition and between both program renames; rerun dispatches the prescribed recovery and preserves committed records.
Kill candidate during startup/migration and kill rollback midway; rerun recovers once and never starts an old app against new data.
Kill after COMMITTED, before gate release/browser open; rerun opens candidate, no old snapshot restoration.
Add new synthetic work after commit, then rerun with a stale old journal/backup; new work survives and automatic downgrade is refused.
Corrupt/missing journal, missing previous tree/snapshot and unsupported journal schema; recovery-required, no best-effort destructive guess.
Full encrypted snapshot verifies and restores into an owned same-account/same-machine isolated destination; login/decryption/integrity pass there.
Different standard Windows account cannot decrypt snapshot or control/remove first user's runtime/data; both profiles unchanged.
IZCNABK1 database-only snapshot rejected for full upgrade recovery with accurate scope message; existing IZCNABK2 backup remains readable.

Abrupt guest power-off immediately before and after every journal-state boundary in the state table, including both program renames, rollback steps, active-write/drain and before/after COMMITTED. Reboot recovers the authoritative state and verifies data. Enumerate each point in the receipt and run each from a restored fixture on Windows 10 Home and Windows 11 Home.
Full/corrupt recovery destination and interrupted plaintext scratch cleanup; fail closed, preserve encrypted backup and protect residual scratch with current-user ACL.
Normal uninstall while stopped/running; program and owned shortcuts disappear, correct process exits, all data and external backups remain.
Reinstall after ordinary uninstall; same accounts/config/keys and records return, no first-use reset.
Repeat ordinary uninstall, absent program with data, shortcut-only remnants; correct idempotent result, data unchanged.
Complete removal using exact typed phrase in disposable profile; owned app/data/recovery snapshots removed; external Documents backup, other user and downloaded ZIP retained.
Cancel normal/full removal, wrong/empty phrase, AssumeYes or NoPause alone; full deletion never begins.

Installed system-bootstrap shortcut and package-root CMD entry points; final helper receipt/exit matches actual deletion, delayed verification proves caller keeps waiting, shortcut is deleted, temporary cleanup failure returns 41.
Locked removal file, denied shortcut deletion, failed process stop and interrupted cleanup; exact partial-failure status and repeatable continuation.
Junction, symlink, path traversal, drive-root/parent substitution, modified shortcut target and same-name unrelated file; unrelated content preserved.
Full removal during pending upgrade/rollback; recover or block first, never erase the only recovery pair implicitly.
Fresh reinstall after confirmed full removal produces a new profile/keys and mandatory first-use setup; old external backup is not silently restored.
Ctrl+C/console close during removal and while waiting for helper; terminal outcome recoverable on rerun and never falsely labeled completed.
Real browser login and navigation: dashboard, treatment plans, checklist, upload, review queue, help and version footer load from bundled assets.
Upload synthetic note/plan, read encrypted content through supported UI/API, review and checklist/timeliness outcomes; same expectations before/after upgrade.
Roles, facility assignments, correction workflow and source/version authorization survive; denied operations stay denied.
Existing login/password change, staff reset, beta.4 recovery-code use and reuse rejection; upgrade itself does not reset passwords.
API configured-state flags and encryption preserved; local mock/OpenAPI flow works, no credential values leaked, production Alleva import remains gated.
Audit-chain continuity, immutable plan/source histories and allowed startup-added rows; no lost/moved evidence.
Deterministic Missing Data/Needs Review/Conflicting Evidence/Unable to Evaluate plus unvalidated LOC configuration remain correct.
Backup -> normal uninstall -> reinstall -> explicitly confirmed restore under same Windows account; end-to-end data usability proved.
Full backend pytest, frontend tests/build, source stack/API smoke and existing lifecycle/stop tests; exact blockers documented, no silent skips.
Full build entry point with required tests enabled; prepared assets, runtime bundle and version/build surfaces validated.
Release directory, ZIP and frozen-bundle payload scans reject canary config/DB/upload/log/credential/test artifacts; safe-name reports only.
PS5.1 short/long path archive regression, malicious ZIP members, duplicate case names, ADS/device paths and reparse entries rejected before extraction.
Generated wrappers/helpers equal expected rendered source; no drift between package/installed implementation; original ZIP hashes unchanged.
Actual packaged office-manager regression on Edge and Chrome where present; server is the candidate EXE, not source Python/Vite.
Helper crash/nonzero exit, noninteractive/NoPause modes, console progress and redaction canaries; results accurate with no secret output.
Final exact-artifact rerun of fresh install, U01/U02, D01/D02/D04 and A01/A02 after packaging completes; evidence tied to final ZIP hash.
